items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today after cracked rib; was GTD with optimism and flak jacket expected.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation; RapSheet earlier bullish on practice/improvement, no WR elevated.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected as WR1/2; docks for rib but playable WR2.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets primary; flak may limit some physicality.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today (hamstring); was not expected/unlikely.
items.why: Official; Schefter source earlier unlikely, ETR not expected.
items.implication: Opens backfield for backups; handcuff/stash time.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed ruled out (neck).
items.why: Official Packers ruling with RT also out.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return mid-game.
items.implication: Monitor return; Gainwell/handcuff elevate if out.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow officially active vs Texans after back soreness/questionable.
items.why: Official confirmation; RapSheet and coaches expected play.
items.implication: Full starter, QB1 despite tough matchup.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT (hamstring); confirmed inactives.
items.why: Pre-weekend out, inactives confirm; HOU thin at WR.
items.implication: Other HOU WRs elevate vs CIN.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave active (hamstring); expected to play clean.
items.why: Listed in actives with Burrow/McMillan; Rap/Schefter expected, Levitan no docks.
items.implication: WR1 role, high target share vs BAL.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; Rap tone bullish, status late.
items.why: Rib improvement, no elevation, flak if plays; docks for limitation.
items.implication: Startable but capped ceiling vs full health.

items.text: Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey sounding doubtful/out.
items.why: Harvey hamstring not expected; Coleman opportunity.
items.implication: Coleman stash/start in deeper; DEN RB volume.

items.text: Michael Pittman OUT (foot); ETR/Levitan note decent look for Germie Bernard.
Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) pre-game/true GTD for MNF vs Giants; no practice.
items.why: Schefter/Rams consider pregame decision; ETR/Levitan true GTD.
items.implication: Monitor warmups; pivot ready if out (TEs/WRs).
items.opportunity: If out, heavier TE/ other WR usage.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers downgraded to OUT (hamstring).
items.why: Saturday downgrade confirmed in inactives; opens targets.
items.implication: Bateman and others elevated; Flowers sit.
items.opportunity: Target share redistribution in BAL offense.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful/out (knee); could return next week after practice.
items.why: Elevated Myarick; Rap notes possible next week.

items.text: Chris Olave sounds fine, no real docks; projecting full.
Loves Kenneth Walker (high util/tgts 40% routes, 74% snaps; IND matchup soft vs Henry).
Loves Ashton Jeanty (99 util score, high target share stretch).
Loves Bucky Irving (tgt share, 100% RZ touches near goal-line).
Hates Travis Etienne (Kamara squeeze, committee with Miller; low early usage concern).
